items.detail: The durable run label is SMOKE_V0_NOT_A_COHORT. This artifact is controlled MVE evidence, not a canonical campaign or ranking cohort.
All three Gemini calls declared a search tool, but retained no normalized search audit, grounding metadata, or tool-use token evidence. Search use is unknown/unproven, never zero or did-not-search.
Private rawResponse fields retain extracted answer text rather than complete provider envelopes, so the missing Gemini search evidence cannot be replayed or recovered.
xAI used 470,958 input tokens and 48 evidenced billable searches versus Gemini at 10,544 input tokens with unknown search use. Cost per pick is not comparable across arms.
xAI recorded 20, 17, and 11 billable searches; the first two exceeded the declared 16-search bound. The operator accepted this before authorizing the frozen fills.
Controlled fills executed serially. The maker was configured for six tracked markets and six realtime channels, exactly the three-game by two-market requirement; this is not spare-capacity evidence.

Terminal evidence records the pre-approved model PositionModule ceiling as a standing exception. Model TreasuryModule allowances were zero; later shared-MVE model PositionModule balances are not attributed to Friday.
The referenced scoring run spans contests 87–90. Moneyline has n=4 per participant; no model beat baseline-away-ml, and the result is descriptive noise rather than ranking evidence.
